title: Synthetic Paragraph Argument Challenge — 1000 New Cases (v2)
origin: Original model-authored fictional examples, generated by parameterised semantic scenario families without running the analyser. No scraped, copyrighted or real-world quotations.
annotation: Labels assigned from explicit scenario logic before analyser scoring. Not independently human-adjudicated. Some examples may need editorial review; preserve v2 and document corrections in a subsequent version.
intended_split: 250 supported, 250 unsupported, 250 contradictory, 125 qualified/undetermined, 125 no inference.
methodology: 40 distinct semantic scenario families, 25 controlled word/number/subject variants per family. New text and labels; the scenarios are correlated, so 1000 rows do not equal 1000 independent argument structures.
evaluation_protocol: Merge corpus-only changes, record the exact analyser commit, run the 1000 examples before changing analyser code or label definitions, and save full results. Keep original v2 snapshot immutable. Hold out independent real-world human-adjudicated samples for external validation.
